answer.rationale: P99 latency spike confined to primary region coinciding with a 2-hour-old release is the clearest causal signal. memory_b1 demonstrates rollback cleared a checkout error spike from a bad build without customer impact. memory_b6 shows staged release gating caught regressions early. Current conditions match: new release + degradation + write-heavy peak. Rollback is fastest path to restore latency during settlement peak. Regional failover would preserve current build but mask the regression; capacity additions won't address causation. Circuit breaker and read routing don't address write path latency. Verification of memory_b1 confirms rollback execution is clean under pressure. This preserves the ability to re-release after analysis while immediately restoring customer write performance.
